Class ElmLibraryWriter

java.lang.Object
network.ike.foundation.ike.elm.ElmLibraryWriter
public final class ElmLibraryWriter extends Object
Records a library as knowledge (IKE-Network/ike-issues#1110, #1112): one concept for the library, one tree semantic per definition about that concept, each definition carrying its name as a description in the CQL dialect, ordered list semantics where order carries meaning, and one reference semantic per thing a definition names. Every identity comes from ElmIdentity, so writing the same library twice finds the same components. The store-side plumbing, stamps, version-aware writes, descriptions, and retirement, is the StoreWriter's.

    • library

      public dev.ikm.tinkar.common.id.PublicId library(String libraryId, String version, String system)
      Records a library: its concept, named by its id, and its identity record, a tree whose root is the ELM Library node holding the versioned identifier as written and the ELM schema identifier every library names.
      Parameters:
      libraryId - the library's id as CQL writes it
      version - the CQL version string, data on the identity record, empty when none
      system - the identifier's system, empty when none
      Returns:
      the library concept's public id

    • definition

      public dev.ikm.tinkar.common.id.PublicId definition(String libraryId, ElmNode root, String name, List<String> operandTypes)
      Records one definition of a library: a tree semantic about the library concept, carrying the definition's name as a description in the CQL dialect.
      Parameters:
      libraryId - the library's id
      root - the definition's root node, an ELM definition kind such as ExpressionDef
      name - the definition's name as written
      operandTypes - the operand type names of a function definition, in order, empty otherwise
      Returns:
      the definition semantic's public id

    • item

      public dev.ikm.tinkar.common.id.PublicId item(String libraryId, ElmNode root, String content)
      Records an unnamed list item: a tree semantic about the library, identified by what it contains.
      Parameters:
      libraryId - the library's id
      root - the item's root node
      content - the item's canonical text, the seed of its identity
      Returns:
      the item semantic's public id

    • orderedList

      public dev.ikm.tinkar.common.id.PublicId orderedList(dev.ikm.tinkar.common.id.PublicId definition, String positionPath, List<dev.ikm.tinkar.common.id.PublicId> items)
      Records an ordered list: the items a list position holds, in order, about the definition whose tree points at it.
      Parameters:
      definition - the definition semantic's public id
      positionPath - the path of positions from the definition's root to the list
      items - the item semantics' public ids, in order
      Returns:
      the list semantic's public id

    • reference

      public dev.ikm.tinkar.common.id.PublicId reference(dev.ikm.tinkar.common.id.PublicId definition, String kindName, dev.ikm.tinkar.common.id.PublicId target, String name, String libraryName)
      Records one thing a definition names, linked to what it means.
      Parameters:
      definition - the definition semantic doing the naming
      kindName - the ELM node kind of the naming node, for example ValueSetRef
      target - the component the name means: a definition semantic, or a unit concept
      name - the name as written
      libraryName - the library name as written, empty for the same library
      Returns:
      the reference semantic's public id
